blocks: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:
Section 4 of the Elections Code is amended to read:
Unless the provision or the context otherwise requires, these general provisions, rules of construction, and definitions govern the construction of this code.
digest: Under existing law, specified general provisions, rules of construction, and definitions govern the Elections Code.
This bill would make nonsubstantive changes to that provision.
label: Introduced
subject: Elections Code: interpretation.
title: An act to amend Section 4 of the Elections Code, relating to elections.
